name: Shah Mosque, Tehran
scope: Standing Qajar mosque precinct in the Tehran Grand Bazaar, including the four court iwans, mapped rectangular basin, north clock and twin minarets, and domed southern prayer hall.
era: Standing Qajar mosque with its late Qajar north tower additions.

originalReview.notes: Qualla and Commons match byte for byte. The drawing also matches the uncropped NYPL institutional copy of the same 1851 lithograph, visibly captioned and credited.

review.notes: Started with the Qualla story media. Used only the exact historical courtyard copy published in 1851 and confirmed against the library plate. Recent attribution-required images and historical photographs with unresolved provenance were excluded.
